reader.requirement: At --std 85 the I-O-CONTROL paragraph must accept SAME {RECORD|SORT|SORT-MERGE} [AREA] [FOR] file-name-1 {file-name-2} ... (AREA and FOR optional words, SORT and SORT-MERGE equivalent per SR3), require at least two file-names that are files of the program's FILE-CONTROL paragraph (SR1), and refuse any other arrangement; the witnesses cover the SORT-MERGE spelling and the one-file refusal, not the optional words, the comma list, several clauses or the undefined name.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Edition.Year < 2002 gives the report-file row its 1985 limits (a report file may be named in any number of SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses, §1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR2); the sort-merge-file and other-file rows, and the format itself, are one arm at every edition
reserved status; SORT-MERGE row true at all four editions

reader.edition-search: grep SameClause/SORT_MERGE in Validation/VersionConformancePass*.cs: none; the grammar rule sameClause has no version predicate; ScreenSameOperands (the arity and SR1/SR2 screen) has no edition test; ScreenSameClauses reaches the edition only through SameOccurrenceRule.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the format: the 1985 sort-merge-area and record-area forms are worded as in 2023; only the report-file occurrence limit (a different rule, §1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR2) has its own 1985 arm
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the optional AREA/FOR words, the comma-separated list, three operands, two SAME clauses in one paragraph, an operand that is no file and the empty list are not exercised by the witnesses

reader.notes: The grammar is a superset (one optional file-name list) and ScreenSameOperands narrows it to the printed arity at bind, at every edition. A first probe set put the sort file and the SORT's USING/GIVING files in one SAME SORT AREA clause and was refused COBOL1757; that refusal is right by §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR9, so the probes name a file outside the SORT. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 locators.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XI.2.5 whole (SR1-6, GR1-2) and CobolIO.g4#sameClause `SAME (RECORD | SORT | SORT_MERGE)? AREA? FOR? fileName (COMMA? fileName)*`, a superset narrowed at bind. Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-01/ (aimed at what the reader did not try): r2-twosort (SAME SORT AREA FOR SF SG, two sort files, both SORTed) runs 'BBBB / DONE'; r2-three (SAME SORT-MERGE AREA FOR SF, SG, X1) runs; r2-noarea-for (SAME SORT SF SG, both optional words omitted) runs; r2-semi (semicolon separator) runs; r2-ext and r2-recext (X1 IS EXTERNAL in SAME SORT / SAME RECORD) COBOL2738 refused, as §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR2 requires; r2-sf2 (SF in two SAME SORT AREA clauses) COBOL2738, as SR5b requires. No 1985-only form and no later-edition form of this clause exists to probe for class c (the 2023 sort-merge-area format is worded the same). cite.py: OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR2; OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5b. Diagnostics cite §2023 locators at --std 85 (wording only).
